# dsh-prompt-file-injector
中文
Injects files you choose into the model context of DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
See design/en/current.md for details.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Installing from GitHub is not supported.
## Features
Adds a configuration area to this plugin's own card on the dsh sidebar's **Plugins** page, where you
list paths and pick how each one reaches the model.
| Mode | What it does |
| System prompt | Injects the file's full text as a fixed system prompt section; it stays present fo

r the whole conversation. |
| Every turn | Puts the file's content back into the conversation on eve
ry turn, so it stays close to the current topic and always reflects the latest content. The cost is

a steady increase in token usage. |
| AGENTS | Adds the file name to the AGENTS loading system dsh s
hips with, so it loads in the workspace the same way `AGENTS.md` does. |
A reminder setting next to the list adds a line near the end of the conversation that points the mod
el back to what was injected into the system prompt: **Off**, **Every turn**, or **Every step**.
Each path can also be limited to one workspace. The AGENTS mode has no such choice and always applie
s in every workspace, so its picker is disabled.
## Settings
| Parameter | Description | Type | Required |

| entries | Paths to inject | array | no |
| entries[].path | A file path, or a file name in the wor

kspace for the AGENTS mode | string | yes |
| entries[].mode | The mode this entry uses: one of `sys

tem`, `everyRound`, `agents` | string | yes |
| entries[].workspaceId | Limit this entry to one work
space; omit it to inject in every workspace. The AGENTS mode ignores it and always applies in every

workspace | string | no |
| reminder | Remind the model near the end of the conversation about what
was injected into the system prompt: `off`, `turn` (once per turn), or `step` (also after each tool

call) | string | no |
| everyRoundInMinimal | Keep injecting the Every turn content in minimal mode,

where the system prompt is owned by the preset's persona (default false) | boolean | no |
| maxFile
Bytes | Byte cap for one file; a larger file is skipped. Applies to the System prompt and Every turn
modes; the AGENTS mode uses the built-in limit (default 65536, entered as KB in the configuration a
rea) | number | no |
A relative path is resolved against the working directory of each conversation; an absolute path is
used as it is. A file that cannot be read, exceeds the cap, or is binary (not text) is skipped silen
as it is. A file that cannot be read, exceeds the cap, or is binary (not text) is skipped silently.
To use one path with two modes, add it as two entries.
